title: B Academics Teaching Roundtable 2026 — Eric joins the global B Corp educator network's fall gathering
summary: B Academics — the global network of educators, researchers, students, and practitioners studying B Lab, B Corp certification, and benefit corporations — hosts its 2026 Teaching Roundtable virtually on Friday October 23 (11 AM–2 PM EDT). Eric joins as a featured speaker. The event brings faculty, students, B Corp representatives, aspiring B corps, and B Lab employees together for the year's flagship teaching-focused convening. Planning committee spans University of Central Oklahoma, University of Maryland, NC State University, and Greater Victoria School District.
blockquote: Join us for the B Academics Teaching Roundtable 2026! More details on topics and speakers are coming soon.
